hero.title: The Cancer Moonshot<sup>SM</sup> Biobank

cards.body: People with cancer donate blood and tissue samples during their treatment, for up to 5 years.
The Biobank receives the samples and sends them to researchers.
Researchers develop ideas to test on many different samples and advance their understanding of cancer.
Researchers work to find discoveries that improve cancer treatments and increase survival.

participate.body: By joining the Biobank, you can be a part of the discovery of new cancer therapies, helping patients everywhere.

cards.body: Participants get a biomarker test, which can help your doctor find new treatments or clinical trials specific to your individual cancer. There is no charge for the test.
cards.title: Biomarker tests tell you more about your cancer.

cards.body: Cancer treatments don't work the same way for everyone—samples from many different communities will help us understand why this is and how to improve cancer care.
cards.title: Diverse participation improves cancer care.

cards.body: By collecting samples over time, researchers can observe how cancer changes and how to stop it from growing and spreading.
cards.title: Together we can advance our understanding of cancer.
